$comment: Authored UNBLOCK probe spec (2026-11-15) for the physical 7050TX-64. Companion to
docs/hw-session-probes.draft.json; this file exists to capture the device VERDICTS that the
blocked Web-UI issues need: VXLAN (#86), routing OSPF/BGP/route-map (#87), STP mode/MST region
grammar (#88) and VRF-Lite (#90).
EVERY batch here is allowCommit:false — the harness stages the lines inside `configure session
hw-probe-<name>`, records `show session-config diffs` + `show configuration sessions detail`, then
ABORTS. Nothing is ever committed to running-config, so default forwarding on the live ports is
untouched, which is exactly the authorization granted on 2026-11-15 (create/modify VXLANs/VRFs etc.
only while default traffic is unaffected). The capture asks only 'does the 4.28.13.1M CLI accept
this grammar', and a refusal (1002/1004) is RECORDED as the batch answer and the loop continues
(DR-134) — a refusal is itself the §3 evidence these issues want.
NO batch uses {{SCRATCH}}: these are global feature-object grammars, not port writes, so this spec
needs NO designated scratch interface and must be run with EAPI_SCRATCH_INTERFACE unset.
WHY the #89 persistence verbs are NOT here: `copy running-config startup-config`, `configure
replace` and `rollback clean-config` are mechanically refused on the hardware lane by
HW_PROBE_FORBIDDEN (rollback / configure-replace) and assertNoPersistenceCommand (copy run start)
in src/testing/hw-capture.ts. The operator's authorized 'default traffic unaffected' scope still
excludes overwriting startup-config or replacing running-config on a live switch. Those three
answers belong to the DISPOSABLE cEOS lane: see scripts/capture-unblock-ceos.mjs. Routing neighbour
TABLES are also a box-only question because cEOS-lab 4.28.14M refuses `ip routing`
(scripts/ceos-lab.mjs PROVISION_TOLERATED) — but enabling `ip routing` on this unit is a FORWARDING
change to its saved `no ip routing` state, so it is deliberately NOT automated; capture it only if
the operator separately accepts that specific global toggle.
RUN (after the §2 env chain in docs/HARDWARE-CAPTURE.md, hardware class; from the repo ROOT use
the npm -w shape — the live project resolves only from arista-api-client/vitest.config.ts):
export EAPI_HW_SESSION_PROBE=1
export EAPI_HW_PROBE_SPEC=$PWD/arista-api-client/docs/hw-capture-unblock.draft.json
npm -w arista-api-client run test:live -- src/hw-session-probe.live.test.ts
Or use scripts/capture-unblock-hw.sh, which sets these and runs the box reads too.

batches.name: unblock-vrf-grammar
batches.question: does 4.28.13.1M accept a named VRF + RD + route-target staged (config# vrf verb the operator saw); abort-only so no VRF persists (feeds B6 #90)

batches.name: unblock-vxlan-grammar
batches.question: does the SKU accept interface Vxlan1 + VNI + source-interface despite 'active:[]' licensing and the refused 'vxlan interface' form; abort-only (feeds B1 #86). The exact 'vxlan interface' command is known-invalid and is deliberately NOT staged

batches.name: unblock-route-map-grammar
batches.question: does the SKU accept a route-map entry staged (config# route-map verb exists per operator console); abort-only (feeds B2 #87)

batches.name: unblock-ospf-grammar
batches.question: does the SKU accept router ospf + router-id + passive-interface staged; abort-only, no adjacency forms (feeds B2 #87)

batches.name: unblock-bgp-grammar
batches.question: does the SKU accept router bgp + router-id + a remote-as neighbor staged; abort-only so the neighbor never lives past the session (feeds B2 #87)

batches.name: unblock-stp-mode-mst-grammar
batches.question: grammar-only: does the CLI accept 'spanning-tree mode mst' staged INSIDE a session that is then ABORTED so STP never reconverges; the #88 blast-radius risk is precisely why this is grammar-only and never committed (feeds B3 #88)

batches.name: unblock-stp-mst-region-grammar
batches.question: does the CLI accept an MST region (name/revision/instance-to-VLAN map) staged; abort-only, never applied (feeds the B3 #88 'should MST region config be exposed at all' decision)
